business.description: The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of customised cable products designed to meet applicable Indian and international standards, customer specifications and project requirements. The Company serves customers across industrial and infrastructure sectors, including power, oil and gas, refineries, petrochemicals, steel, cement, chemicals, water and desalination, metro rail, airports, renewable energy and other infrastructure-related applications.

outlook.statement: The Company remains focused on strengthening its product portfolio, enhancing quality systems, widening its customer base, increasing export opportunities and pursuing growth in industrial and infrastructure sectors. The Company will continue to evaluate opportunities based on its product capability, applicable technical standards, customer requirements, commercial viability and prudent risk assessment. Based on the information presently available and the prevailing business environment, the Board does not foresee any material adverse change in the future prospects of the Company's business.
Efforts shall continue to expand the geographical reach on export market to maximize foreign exchange inflow and to minimize the foreign exchange outflow.
The Company continues to evaluate the adoption of renewable energy sources and other energy-efficient technologies with a view to improving sustainability and reducing its environmental footprint.
The Company also evaluates the use of artificial intelligence to enhance operational efficiency and business processes in a responsible manner.

The long-term demand fundamentals for the wires and cables industry remain supportive. Global investment in electricity generation, transmission and distribution networks, renewable-energy integration, grid modernisation, electrification of transport and industry, industrial automation, data centres and digital connectivity is expected to require continued expansion and strengthening of electricity and communication infrastructure.

The International Energy Agency forecasts global electricity demand to grow by an average of 3.6% annually during 2026–2030, driven by industrial consumption, electric vehicles, air conditioning and data centres. Annual global grid investment needs to increase by approximately 50% by 2030 from the current level of about USD 400 billion.
Global data-centre electricity consumption is expected to more than double from approximately 415 TWh in 2024 to around 945 TWh by 2030.

The Indian economic environment during FY 2025–26 provided favourable demand conditions for the wires and cables industry. The medium- to long-term outlook remains supported by infrastructure development, power-sector investment, renewable-energy expansion, manufacturing growth, urbanisation and digitalisation.

The medium- to long-term outlook for the Indian wires and cables industry remains constructive, supported by India's infrastructure-development agenda, transition towards cleaner energy, manufacturing growth, urbanisation and expanding digital infrastructure.

CORDS® remains focused on building a sustainable and scalable business across a broad range of cable products serving industrial, infrastructure and emerging end-use sectors. The Company intends to broaden its customer base across existing and emerging application areas, subject to its product capabilities, technical standards, customer-approval requirements and commercial-risk parameters.

The Company expects that the initiatives relating to process improvement, cost optimisation, preventive maintenance, production planning, product mix and capacity utilisation will support improvement in productivity, operational efficiency and profitability over the medium term. However, the extent of such improvement cannot, at this stage, be quantified with reasonable certainty in numerical terms.

risks: The Company does not foresee any material risks that could adversely impact the Company's operations or continuity as on the date of this Report.
The Board is of the opinion that there are no significant risks that may threaten the existence of the Company.

The Company remains committed to enhancing investor services and maintaining high standards of stakeholder engagement through transparent, responsive, and efficient communication.

As part of its investor outreach initiatives, the Company encourages shareholders to register and update their e-mail addresses to enable electronic receipt of the Annual Report, Notice of the Annual General Meeting, e-voting credentials, and other statutory communications. Shareholders are also periodically advised to update their bank account details and other relevant particulars to facilitate seamless electronic credit of dividends and ensure compliance with the applicable provisions relating to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS).

In accordance with the applicable SEBI circulars, shareholders holding shares in physical form are required to furnish their Permanent Account Number (PAN), Know Your Customer (KYC) details, including postal address with PIN code, e-mail address, mobile number, bank account particulars, specimen signature, and nomination details.
